task.description:
Run the full test suite for PD-07 and produce a test report.

### Commands to run

```bash
zig build
zig build test
```

Both commands must be run. Capture exit codes and full output.

### Test report

Write the test report to `tests/reports/WF02-pd07-20260521-test-report.json` using the standard report format from `docs/guides/test_developer_guide.md` §8.

The report MUST include:
- Overall status: PASS or FAIL
- Exit codes for `zig build` and `zig build test`
- Total test count, passed count, failed count
- Per-test results for all TC-PD-07-XX cases
- Any regressions in previously passing tests (graph_test.zig, graph_node_attributes_test.zig, graph_edge_conditions_test.zig)
- Full stderr output if any test fails

If any tests fail, set `result.status = "FAIL"` and list all failures in `result.issues` with severity = "BLOCKING".
